description: The terms \(f(x_0,x_0)\) and \(f(x_1,a)\) unify, but the first does not match the second.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.matching_counterexample.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (f : L.Functions 2)
  (a : L.Functions 0) :
  (∃ σ,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ
        [(Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.binary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 0) (FirstOrder.Language.var 0),
            Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.binary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 1)
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.constant a))]) ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Matches
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.binary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 0) (FirstOrder.Language.var 0))
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.binary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 1)
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.constant a))
